author: Midnightas
body:
I have been banned by hacking at around 2012-2013 and wish to appeal this ban.
(Server-fly, client-side flying).
Here are the 3 points in that was mentioned on the pinned thread:

Minecraft Username: Midnightas (Was BadBoy6767 when I was banned.)
Ban reason: Client and Server side flying.
Appeal reason: My attitude back then was when I was like 10, and thought it was a temp-ban. And now I'm actually feel bad for hacking as I grew out of it 10 months ago.

Thank you for reading.
